title: Japan attacks Pearl Harbor
summary: Japanese carrier aircraft struck the US Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor in Hawaii, sinking or damaging eight battleships and killing about 2,400 Americans.
reason: Japan wanted to cripple the US fleet so it could seize the resource-rich colonies of South-East Asia after the United States cut off its oil.
significance: It brought the United States into the Second World War and turned the conflict into a truly global war.
place: Pearl Harbor, Oahu, Hawaii, United States
